logfiles.description: List of logfile paths to monitor directly via positional arguments. Items should be strings representing the path.

debug_window.description: Parses first logfile only and adds a debug output window.

checkpoint_interval.description: Set checkpoint interval in seconds (0 will disable checkpoints).

currency_token_rate.description: Token conversion rate as a positive floating point number. -1 disables manual rate.

glob_paths.description: List of nix 'glob' paths to match multiple files.

glob_scan.description: Enable periodic scan of any glob paths every so many seconds. 0 to disable.

lines_max.description: Maximum number of lines to display for each logfile.

timeline_steps.description: Steps in each timeline for timeline graphs.
